mandate: C425 — test the price-only RQA: recurrence quantification analysis (recurrence rate, determinism, laminarity, trapping time of diagonal/vertical line structures in delay-embedding space) stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t] / trailing log-returns X=r[t-W+1..t]: delay embedding E in R^(N_emb x m), N_emb=W-(m-1)*tau=254, m=3, tau=1, row k=[X[k],X[k+1],X[k+2]]; pairwise Chebyshev distance D_ab=||E_a-E_b||_inf; recurrence threshold eps=0.1*sigma_window; recurrence matrix R_ab=1{D_ab<=eps}; rqa_rr=(1/N_emb^2)sum R_ab; rqa_det=diagonal-line determinism (l>=l_min=2); rqa_lam=vertical-line laminarity (v>=v_min=2); rqa_tt=mean vertical line length (v>=v_min=2). NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in C[t-W..t], N_emb<10, or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (rqa_rr_dev, rqa_det_dev, rqa_lam_dev, rqa_tt_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W+1-bar close window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t] / trailing log-returns X=r[t-W+1..t]; delay embedding E in R^(N_emb x m), N_emb=W-(m-1)*tau=254, m=3, tau=1, row k=[X[k],X[k+1],X[k+2]]; pairwise Chebyshev distance D_ab=||E_a-E_b||_inf; recurrence threshold eps=0.1*sigma_window; recurrence matrix R_ab=1{D_ab<=eps}; rqa_rr=(1/N_emb^2)*sum R_ab; rqa_det=diagonal-line determinism (l>=l_min=2); rqa_lam=vertical-line laminarity (v>=v_min=2); rqa_tt=mean vertical line length (v>=v_min=2).
methodology.signals: rqa_rr/rqa_det/rqa_lam/rqa_tt over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.rqa_vectorization_note: close matrix C=(T,10) built once; per asset, log-return series X[j]=log(c[j+1]/c[j]); embedding E_full[j]=[X[j],X[j+1],X[j+2]] via sliding_window_view; per window ending at t, embedding rows E_full[t-W .. t-3] (N_emb=254); pairwise Chebyshev distance in bounded chunks; epsilon=0.1*std of window returns; recurrence matrix R=1{D<=eps}; diagonal/vertical line run-lengths from boolean recurrence matrices; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit embedding + distance matrix + RQA measures, maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
